name: Mink Deluxe
source: Mink fandisc. This disc contains wallpapers and system sounds from various Mink games for Windows, as well as an original CD voice drama for game "GOKKO vol1.2/SCHOOL GAL's" in the form of CD-DA audio track.
translation: 水貂同人唱片。该光盘包含Windows下各种Mink游戏的壁纸和系统声音，以及CD-DA音轨形式的游戏“GOKKO vol1.2/SCHOOL GAL's”的原创CD语音剧。
